title: Footnotes
statementMd:
Your colleague Cynthia likes writing asides in messages (but then again, don't we all (and there's nothing strictly wrong with that anyway)). As some people find the text hard to read this way, we are going to try to extract some parts of the sentences out into equally-sized footnotes instead of brackets.

For example, `this(complicated(nested(passage)))` could become:

`this[1]` `[1] complicated[2]` `[2] nested(passage)`

Given one such message, an unbroken string of up to $10^6$ characters (letters and brackets, without any spaces), isolate exactly two-thirds of the Latin letters into footnotes, each footnote containing exactly the same number of Latin letters.

## Input

- One line containing a string $s$ ($1 \le |s| \le 10^6$), each character in $s$ being a lowercase letter or an opening/closing round bracket.

It is guaranteed that the brackets in $s$ are properly matched and that the content of a pair of brackets is always non-empty.

## Output

Output three lines in the form shown above, using exactly two footnotes in square brackets to indicate where passages were relocated. If there is no way of doing this, output `impossible` instead.

Your answer will be tested by substituting the footnotes back (inside brackets) and comparing character-by-character with the original text.
statementZhMd:
你的同事 Cynthia 喜欢在消息中加入题外话（不过话说回来，我们不都这样吗（而且这样做本身也没什么不妥））。有些人觉得这样的文字读起来很费劲，因此我们打算尝试将句子中的某些部分提取出来，放入长度相同的脚注中，而不再使用圆括号。

例如，`this(complicated(nested(passage)))` 可以变为：

`this[1]` `[1] complicated[2]` `[2] nested(passage)`

给定这样一条消息，它是一个最长为 106106 个字符的连续字符串（由字母和圆括号组成，不含空格），请将其中恰好三分之二的拉丁字母提取到脚注中，且每条脚注包含的拉丁字母数量必须完全相同。

## 输入格式

- 一行，包含一个字符串 𝑠s（1≤|𝑠|≤1061≤|s|≤106），𝑠s 中的每个字符都是小写字母、左圆括号或右圆括号。

保证 𝑠s 中的圆括号正确匹配，且每对圆括号中的内容始终非空。

## 输出格式

按照上面展示的形式输出三行，恰好使用两条脚注，并用方括号标记被移走的片段原本所在的位置。如果无法做到，则输出 `impossible`。

评测时，会将脚注内容放回原处（并用圆括号括起来），然后与原文逐字符比较，以检验你的答案。
